tools.name: get_basis_signal
tools.description: Combined entry signal: basis regime + liquidity check. Returns signal (ENTER_*_BIAS/HOLD), z-score, maxNeutralUsd, recommended action. Params: exchangeA, exchangeB, symbol, maxSizeUsd (optional cap).

tools.name: list_hedge_positions
tools.description: All hedged positions of the user (open and closed).

tools.name: get_agent_events
tools.description: Engine event feed for a position (slices, funding collected, alerts, liquidation). Params: positionId (optional), limit (default 30).

tools.description: List open orders on an exchange (REAL). Params: exchange ("binance"|"bingx"|"bybit"), symbol (optional, e.g. "BTC_USDT"). binance = futures open orders, bybit = linear perps; bingx spot returns unsupported (single-order query only).

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Close an open position from our registry (user_positions): market reduce-only on the exchange (binance/bingx/bybit), cancel exchange SL/TP, record realized PnL. Params: exchange, symbol (e.g. "BTC_USDT"). Returns fill price and PnL.

tools.description: Set/update exchange-side stop-loss and take-profit on an open position (REAL; binance futures, bybit linear; bingx spot unsupported). Params: exchange, symbol, stopLossPct/takeProfitPct (percent from entry) or absolute stopLossPrice/takeProfitPrice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tickers, get_agent_events · Private data: close_position · Public sink: agent_chat, square_post · Destructive: agent_trigger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tickers, get_agent_events · Private data: close_position · Public sink: agent_chat, square_post · Destructive: agent_trigger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
